title: Redundant H7 storage — DNS/DHCP remainder converts slowly; new rack grows data
motto: Each rack adds redundant shard capacity. DNS and DHCP keep only what they need; remainder converts to field-h7s-fs. Super secure — no outside internet on the storage plane.

security.motto: Super secure from outside internet — truth DNS/DHCP internal; redundant pool never public.

conversion.note: Unused DNS/DHCP quota on each rack migrates into h7-shard/redundant-pool.json over time

growth.formula: total_redundant_gb = sum(converted_gb per rack); new rack += per_rack_gb convertible over cycles
